{{Top|leg}}
'''Transplas''',<ref name="ES">{{WEGCite|story=The Event of the Season|book=Tapani Sector Instant Adventures}}</ref> also known as '''transplast''',<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> was a strong, clear material. It was used in the construction of [[transphere]]s, which were used by attendees of the [[Unification Gala]] for zero-[[Gravity/Legends|gee]] dancing. The material was strong enough to protect the occupants inside if the sphere ever fell out of the air.<ref name="ES" /> The [[Air-2 racing swoop]] manufactured by [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] could be purchased with an optional transplas windscreen.<ref name="EGVV" />
